items.summary: Citi believes the recent sell-off in memory chip stocks presents a buying opportunity, arguing that the artificial intelligence-driven memory cycle is still in its early phases and could ultimately exceed the industry’s previous boom between 2001 and 2007. The bank says the current environment shares many similarities with the long NAND expansion seen during the early 2000s, when products such as MP3 players and digital cameras transformed demand and flash memory steadily replaced older storage
